Coral Springs Project Case Study

Modern Dark Oak Kitchen Remodel

A warm Coral Springs kitchen renovation featuring rich dark oak cabinetry, granite surfaces, stainless appliances and an open island layout.

Request a Free EstimateExplore the Project
LocationCoral Springs, Florida
Project TypeComplete Kitchen Renovation
Design StyleUrban Contemporary
Featured FinishDark Oak Cabinetry
Project Overview

Warm materials. Clean modern function.

This Coral Springs kitchen remodel brings depth and character to an open living space through dark wood cabinetry and a highly practical layout.

Rich dark oak cabinetry gives the kitchen a sophisticated urban feel, while stainless-steel appliances and simple bar hardware keep the design crisp and contemporary. Granite countertops provide a durable work surface, and the broad island creates a natural transition between the kitchen and adjacent living area. The result is a comfortable, efficient space with generous storage and a strong visual identity.

CabinetryDark oak flat-panel cabinetry with slim metal pulls
CountertopsPolished granite work surfaces
AppliancesCoordinated stainless-steel appliance suite
LayoutOpen kitchen with a wide central island
Design Highlights

Distinctive details shaped around daily life.

Rich Cabinetry

Dark wood cabinetry adds warmth, depth and an upscale contemporary character.

Open Island Layout

The broad island supports meal preparation while connecting the kitchen to the living space.

Stainless Appliance Suite

Coordinated appliances provide durability and a clean modern contrast.

Granite Work Surfaces

Natural stone counters offer lasting performance and visual texture.

Maximized Storage

Tall pantry cabinets and deep drawers help make efficient use of the available footprint.

Simple Hardware

Slim metallic pulls reinforce the kitchen’s streamlined architectural lines.
